user.description: Configure billing and charging, then choose one email method. The next step shows only settings for that method. No email saves local invoices only. Gmail (Google app password) needs no connected Google Mail account. Schedule times are saved to the minute.

invoice_billing.title: Invoice Billing Options
invoice_billing.description: Choose how the monthly invoice groups recorded charging: individual daily tariff/rate lines, combined daily charges, monthly tariff totals or one monthly total. Fees and tax remain separate; totals and recorded rates do not change. Older usage without daily detail remains a labelled summary. The branded invoice layout is automatically populated from seller/customer and payment settings and attached as a PDF whenever invoice email is enabled. This does not change the monthly sending schedule or send a test email.

tariffs.description: Define Peak, Off Peak, Shoulder 1, Shoulder 2 and EV Night. Enable only bands you use. From is inclusive; To is exclusive; overnight windows are supported. Overlaps are rejected. Uncovered times use the default rate. A selected sensor overrides the manual rate when valid; unavailable/invalid sensors use the manual fallback and are reported. Manual rates exclude tax. Mark tax-inclusive sensor prices (such as Haggle) to remove the included tax before invoice tax is applied. Charging switch control remains separate.

error.invalid_time: Choose a valid local time. Times are saved to the minute.

error.invalid_currency: Enter a three-letter currency code, such as AUD.
error.invalid_power_sensor: Select an existing power sensor measured in W or kW.
error.switch_required: Select a charger switch before enabling automatic control.
error.invalid_switch: Select an existing switch or clear the optional switch field.

error.invalid_email_gmail_oauth: Connect Google Mail in Home Assistant, select the sending account and enter the invoice recipient.
error.invalid_email_custom: Complete the SMTP server, login, sender and invoice recipient settings.
error.invalid_email: For connected Gmail, authorize Google Mail, select the account and enter the invoice recipient. For SMTP, complete login and sender settings. Otherwise turn off automatic email.
error.currency_locked: Currency cannot change on an existing billing account.
